quote: Zimbabwe Current Situation – From the period 8‐17 March 2009, a total of 2,237 cases were reported reflecting a 58% decrease from the 3,812 cases recorded in the previous week (1‐7 March 2009). The number of deaths during 13 to 20 March 2009 decreased to 50 compared to 79 the previous week, indicating a 63% reduction. Cumulative community deaths, however, remained high at 61.5%. The cumulative number of cholera cases since August 2008 as at 17 March 2009 is 91,164, with 4, 037 deaths, while the case fatality rate (CFR) decreased and is now at 4.4%. The reduction in cases has been attributed to the coordinated cholera response, including better case management, increased WASH activities, greater social mobilization, enhanced logistics, improved environmental health and more vigilant surveillance at both national and provincial level.
